name: Commerce Paybox Payment
description: Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Paybox/Verifone with signature-verified return handling and a direct API service.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 Paybox integration for the Drupal Commerce payment and checkout system.

This module carries part of the functionality of the module on Drupal 8/9,

Paybox Service method using Commerce Payment Gateway is implemented here.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 General requirements 
 Required modules

* Drupal Commerce:

 * Commerce Payment

 Paybox Service specific requirements 
 * PHP OpenSSL must be enabled on your server (see documentation for how to enable it).

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 * Install Commerce module

* Install Commerce Paybox Payment Module

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 * Add Paybox gateway in admin/commerce/config/payment-gateways/add

* Choice Paybox Plugin

* Testing Data can be found in bank documentation (French doc available only)
